summary: iter-36 Phase-A HRMS (SalaryBox-style) verification: 12/12 backend pytest passed and full frontend E2E flow verified. All new endpoints (GET /api/payroll/staff/{sid}/summary, PATCH /api/attendance/{aid}, extended PATCH /api/payroll/{pid} with overtime_pay/other_earnings/reimbursements_paid/early_fine/advance/loan_deduction, GET /api/reports/{attendance,payroll,consolidated}) return correct shape and headers. Net recalc verified: overtime_pay+other_earnings+reimbursements_paid = gross(1550), advance+loan_deduction+early_fine = deductions(750), net=800. Frontend: /hrms Staff tab renders staff-salary-<id> icon (158 rows), navigates to /hrms/staff/<id>/salary rendering StaffSalaryDetail with all required testids (back-btn, month/year-select, summary/attendance/earnings/deductions cards, 3 download buttons, salary-history). Edit Components modal shows all 8 verified new fields; save persisted and net updated. CSV download triggers a real file (attendance_*.csv). Payroll tab shows rep-attendance/payroll/consolidated buttons and 538 view-detail-<id> buttons that navigate correctly.

minor.issue: Role allow-list includes 'manager' and 'center_manager' in addition to admin/hr. Spec said HR/admin only. Not blocking — matches previous conventions — but flag to product to confirm intent (managers can rewrite historical attendance for their team).

issues: Console warnings about Recharts container width(-1)/height(-1) on initial paint. Pre-existing, not part of this iteration.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Confirm intended role allow-list for PATCH /api/attendance/{aid} — currently allows admin/hr/manager/center_manager. Spec wording implied HR/admin only.

OPTIONAL: The test-manager mgr2 has role='manager' not 'staff', so the 'staff role cannot PATCH attendance' assertion was replaced with an unauth (401/403) check. If a plain staff-role test account is important for future RBAC testing, seed one.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3614 PATCH /attendance/{aid} — role allow-list [admin, hr, manager, center_manager] wider than spec suggested. edited_by/edited_at correctly stamped from user['id'] and UTC iso. Idempotent (returns doc if empty patch). OK.

server.py:5186 _recalc_payroll — correctly sums extended earnings (overtime_pay + other_earnings + reimbursements_paid) into gross and extended deductions (early_fine + advance + loan_deduction) into deductions. Rounded to 2dp. Verified numerically (gross=1550, deductions=750, net=800).
server.py:5338 PATCH /payroll/{pid} — correctly blocks edits on status='paid' (HTTP 400) and merges partial fields via {**rec, **update} before recompute. edited_by/edited_at stamped. Good.

server.py:5452 staff_salary_summary — attendance breakdown counts 'half' as +1 to half AND +0.5 to present (for pay calc) which is what the frontend Attendance card expects. history returns max 24 months. Bank account masked. OK.

server.py:5638 report_payroll CSV — headers match spec exactly (Basic, HRA, DA, Conveyance, Bonus, Incentive, Overtime, Other Earnings, Reimb Paid, Gross, PF, ESI, Late Fine, Early Fine, Advance, Loan EMI, Total Deductions, Net, Status, Paid At, Bank Name, Account #, IFSC, PAN). Verified.
server.py:5711 report_consolidated — one row per staff with attendance summary + payroll + bank. Uses status='unpaid' fallback when no payroll doc exists. Correct.

StaffSalaryDetail.jsx — all 20+ required data-testids present (back-btn, month-select, year-select, summary-card, run-payroll-btn conditional, edit-payroll-btn, attendance-card, earnings-card, deductions-card, download-attendance/payroll/consolidated, salary-history, edit-payroll-modal, payroll-<field> for 8+ fields, save-payroll-btn). Verified via query_selector.

HRMS.jsx:883 staff-salary-<id> icon renders per staff row; HRMS.jsx:1220-1222 rep-attendance/payroll/consolidated buttons render on Payroll tab; HRMS.jsx:1249 view-detail-<id> renders per payroll row and navigates to /hrms/staff/<sid>/salary?month=&year= — verified 538 rows.

Test data note: Many auto-provisioned staff rows exist (TEST_MgrStaff_*, TEST_EmpStaff_*) — 158 staff-salary buttons and 538 view-detail buttons rendered. No pagination on either list — consider adding for scale (>500 rows on a single tab is heavy).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Phase-A testids present, edit modal + save + CSV download all working)

seed_data_creation: One attendance row inserted for sample staff on 2026-07-15 via POST /api/attendance if none existed. One payroll row PATCHed with test values (overtime=1000/300/250 earn, 500/200/50 ded) on July 2026 for the first staff with monthly_salary set. Downstream tests do not clean these up because payroll rows are expected to persist for the month.
